basic_info.description: This good sized one bedroom condominium is located on the building's third floor which has access to the large outdoor common space and in addition has two private patios areas, access from both the living room and bedroom - a rare find! Appliances have been updated, in unit washer & dryer.  Easy access to transportation - walk to Muni Metro & BART, Tech busses stop in front of the building and if desired parking is available in the building.
